entities.name: PMID:25426190
observations: Owusu et al. 2014 studied 82 children at Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital with fever-associated convulsions or acute encephalopathy of unclear cause.
Authors concluded non-polio enteroviruses were not etiologic agents of neurological morbidity in the studied cohort; no separate control group was reported.

entities.name: No enterovirus causation at Korle-Bu
observations: In 82 children studied at Korle-Bu, the reported enterovirus isolation rate was about 0.67%; a vaccine-origin poliovirus was characterized as normal Sabin virus, and the authors found no evidence that non-polio enteroviruses caused the neurological morbidity.
